capabilities: Search metadata from Bangumi, AniList, and Open Library
Track progress, status, dates, and ratings in Markdown media notes
Rank completed works through pairwise cover comparisons
Insert reusable Image Sections and Moments into media notes
Export the library, scoreboard, and ranking as JSON, text, or PNG
disambiguation: Despite the name, it catalogs manga and novels as well as anime.
extras: README carries a caution section advising vault backup or sync before running cleanup tools, since update operations can modify or remove files; ranking data lives in a separate .obsidian/animelist-ranking.json file that should be included in backups. Detailed usage documentation lives in an external User Guide. The interface supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to catalog and track watched/read media with structured metadata, progress, ratings, and cover images.
